_comment: Historic demo data (W4-08): SYNTHETIC conversations for the admin dashboards. Each scenario is a kind of turn; the builder (apps/api/src/modules/workspace/historic.ts) draws ~120 conversations from them over the 14 days before 'today', with a fixed seed. weight = relative frequency.

questions: How many days of annual leave do I get?
How much PTO do I have per year?
Can I carry over unused vacation days?
scenarios.answer: Full-time employees in the US receive 20 days of paid annual leave a year, accrued monthly [S1]. Up to 5 unused days carry over to the next year [S1].

questions: How much holiday am I entitled to?
Do bank holidays count towards my annual leave?
scenarios.answer: Full-time employees in the UK receive 25 days of paid annual leave plus the 8 UK bank holidays [S1]. After 5 years of service it rises to 27 days [S1].

questions: My VPN keeps disconnecting. What should I do?
How do I connect to the VPN from home?
GlobalProtect says the portal is unreachable
scenarios.answer: Restart GlobalProtect and sign in again with MFA [S1]. If it still drops, switch from Wi-Fi to a wired connection and check the portal address is vpn.example.com [S1].

questions: How often do I have to change my password?
How do I reset my MFA on a new phone?
scenarios.answer: Passwords expire every 90 days and must be at least 14 characters [S1]. To move MFA to a new phone, use the self-service portal while signed in on your laptop [S1].

questions: What is the daily meal allowance when travelling?
What hotel rate can I book on a business trip?
scenarios.answer: On business travel the daily meal allowance is 60 in the local currency [S1]. Hotels should stay within the city rate listed in the travel tool [S1].

questions: How do I connect to the office printer?
Where do I pick up secure prints?
scenarios.answer: Add the printer FollowMe-Print from the Software Centre, then release your job at any printer with your badge [S1].

questions: How many sick days do I get?
Do I need a doctor's note for sick leave?
scenarios.answer: You receive 10 paid sick days a year [S1]. A doctor's note is needed after 3 consecutive days [S1].

questions: Can I expense a standing desk for working from home?
Is there an allowance for a home office chair?
Will the company pay for my home internet?
Can I claim a second monitor for home?
scenarios.answer: The expenses policy covers business travel and client meals [S1]. It does not say whether home office equipment can be claimed.
uncovered: Home office equipment or internet allowances

questions: Do contractors get parental leave?
Can I take paternity leave as a contractor?
Is maternity leave paid for agency contractors?
scenarios.answer: Contractors arrange time off with their agency [S1]. The policy does not say how parental leave works for contractors.

questions: How do I get a parking permit for the office?
Is there staff parking at the London office?
Who do I ask about a car park space?
scenarios.answer: I could not find a policy on office parking. I can raise a request with HR General for you.

fields.question: How to get an office parking permit

questions: Can I take a sabbatical?
Is there a career break policy?
How long can unpaid leave be?
scenarios.answer: I could not find a sabbatical or career-break policy. I can raise a request with HR General.

questions: My laptop will not turn on even when plugged in
My laptop screen stays black after the update
The keyboard on my laptop stopped working
scenarios.answer: Try a hard reset: hold the power button for 15 seconds, then plug in the charger [S1]. If that does not help, I have prepared a hardware request for IT.

questions: I need access to the finance SharePoint site
Please give me access to the Jira project for Northwind
I need admin rights on the build server
scenarios.answer: Access needs your manager's approval [S1]. I have prepared an access request for IT Access.

questions: Please install Visual Studio on my laptop
I need Tableau Desktop installed
Can I get Docker Desktop?
scenarios.answer: Licensed software is requested through IT [S1]. I have prepared a software request.

questions: My payslip shows the wrong tax code
My overtime is missing from this month's pay
I was paid less than my contract salary
scenarios.answer: Pay corrections are handled by Payroll [S1]. I have prepared a request with the details.

questions: My laptop battery is swollen and getting hot
My laptop smells of burning plastic
scenarios.answer: Stop using the laptop now, unplug it and move it away from anything flammable [S1]. I have raised an urgent request for IT.

questions: My manager keeps humiliating me in team meetings
A colleague is making comments that make me uncomfortable
scenarios.answer: I am sorry this is happening. This is something an HR advisor should handle privately. Would you like me to open a confidential case?

questions: it is broken
doesn't work again
help please
scenarios.answer: Could you tell me what is not working — your laptop, an app, or your access?

questions: Can you recommend a good restaurant nearby?
What will the weather be tomorrow?
scenarios.answer: I can help with IT and HR questions, your timesheets, pay and requests. For anything else, please use the usual channels.
